messages:
maria: FYI opened docs PR to refresh the hello quickstart auth snippet + first-deploy flow. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 Fixes: token example, docker run flags, and a broken link to private deploy page. PTAL if you can this morning.

devon: On it, will glance. main snag was auth snippet using old env var REDWOOD_API_KEY instead of REDWOOD_KEY?

maria: yep, changed to REDWOOD_API_TOKEN and added note about scopes. Also updated the Node and Python SDK snippets to new client constructors.

sanjay: can you paste the new Node snippet? want to test in starter app.

maria: Node snippet:
```
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN })
const res = await client.generate('Hello')
```

devon: looks good, but the import path should be '@redwood/inference' in docs for SDK v3. We renamed packages in the migration guide. See https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/wiki/sdk-migration.

maria: ah good catch, changing. Also removed the deprecated docker flag `--gpus all` from the examples and added a note for Apple Silicon users to use `--platform=linux/amd64` when building the image.

ash: CI failed linting on trailing whitespace, small nit. I'll push a fix.

docs-bot: link-checker: PR #842 - broken link found: /docs/private-deploy -> 404

maria: fixed link to /products/private-deploy and added a redirect note.

devon: I can run the sample quickly and confirm. If green from CI, let's merge by EOD.

ash: pushed commit for lint, also updated test snippet for python to show async usage.

sanjay: tested quickstart locally, auth flow works, Docker run note helpful. Left two comments on PR about wording.

maria: addressed comments, replied, and re-ran CI.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview for PR #842 is live at https://deployments.preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-842 (expires in 3 days)

devon: :thumbsup:

maria: :tada: thanks everyone. merging once approvers + CI green. I'll follow up to backport to 2.0 branch.
